caption: Figure 2. A high level overview of the Virgo microarchi- tecture. The Gemmini-based matrix unit is disaggregated out from the SIMT cores into a separate unit in the cluster. Dashed lines indicate optionally instantiated modules for evaluation, such as the core-coupled Tensor Core.

templates.why_chosen: The reference doc's own canonical block-floorplan example: two SIMT cores sit beside a disaggregated Gemmini systolic array, with a right-side legend naming exactly three traffic colors (main-memory, shared-memory, DMA) across 31 components.
templates.what_to_learn: Cap the traffic-color legend at three classes exactly, put it in a free column on the right, and use dashed module outlines for hardware blocks that only exist in some evaluation configurations; expect this density (277 shapes) to require careful, uncluttered grouping into named regions (Tensor Core, Shared Memory, Gemmini).
